reply: The University of Sargodha (UOS) is a public-sector university located in Sargodha, Punjab, Pakistan. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and research education across a range of disciplines. The university provides teaching facilities, laboratories, a central library, student hostels, sports facilities and academic support services.
The University of Sargodha's main campus is located on University Road, Sargodha, Punjab, Pakistan. Its postal code is 40100.
The University of Sargodha's published general contact number is 048 111 867 111. You can also visit the university's main campus on University Road, Sargodha, for in-person enquiries.

According to UOS's published admissions FAQ, regular admissions generally open in August or September. Admissions for the Faculty of Pharmacy, Medical and Allied Health Sciences generally open in October or November. These are usual admission periods; the exact dates for a particular session are announced separately.

keywords: how can i apply for admission
reply: UOS regular admissions use an online application process. First, choose an advertised program and review its eligibility criteria. Then complete the admission application with your personal and academic information. Generate and pay the prescribed application-fee challan, and upload the scanned paid challan as instructed. After submission, follow the merit-list schedule. If selected, complete document verification and the remaining admission formalities within the announced deadline.

For regular online admission, UOS says applicants do not need to send physical academic documents to the admission office at the initial application stage. The paid challan is uploaded to the admission portal. After selection, applicants must provide the required academic and identity documents for verification. Keep your CNIC or B-Form, previous academic result cards and certificates, photographs and applicable equivalence certificates ready. The final document checklist depends on your program and admission notice.

keywords: can i apply for multiple programs
how many programs can i apply
apply for more than one program
reply: Yes. According to the UOS admissions FAQ, an applicant may apply for up to eight programs of interest, provided the applicant satisfies the eligibility requirements of the chosen programs.

keywords: can i apply with hope certificate
reply: No. According to the published UOS regular-admission FAQ, applicants must have an official result card before the admission deadline. A hope certificate or result-awaiting status alone is not sufficient for online application under that stated rule.

UOS calculates admission merit according to the requirements of each program. Academic marks and any applicable admission-test or program-specific criteria are considered under the relevant admission policy. Because formulas can differ between BS, professional and postgraduate programs, one fixed percentage formula cannot accurately represent every program.

keywords: how to know i am selected
reply: UOS publishes the merit lists of successful applicants according to the admission schedule. Applicants should find the merit list for their selected department and program, check their application details or merit position, and complete the required fee payment and document verification if selected. Being selected does not remove the obligation to meet the announced reporting and fee deadlines.

UOS's published FAQ states that admission tests are conducted for MS, MPhil and PhD programs, ADCP, the MSc Physical Education fitness assessment, and drawing tests for relevant Institute of Art and Design BS programs. Requirements can differ between programs and admission sessions.

keywords: how old can i be to apply
reply: The UOS admissions FAQ lists an age limit of 24 years for BS programs and 26 years for MA/MSc programs. It also lists exemptions, including MPhil/PhD, BEd, MBA Executive and certain other categories. Age-limit requirements and exemptions should be assessed under the regulations for the admission session concerned.

Applicants with O-Level, A-Level or certain foreign qualifications are required to provide an equivalence certificate from the Inter Board Committee of Chairmen (IBCC). UOS's published FAQ allows provisional admission subject to submitting the required equivalence certificate before the first semester or first annual examination, as applicable.

UOS does not have one fixed semester fee for every student. The payable amount depends on the degree program, regular or self-support category, academic session and applicable university charges. The exact rupee amount cannot be correctly determined without the program and current fee schedule. An applicant must use the approved fee schedule or issued challan for the relevant program rather than assuming that another department's fee is the same.

To pay a UOS fee, first obtain the challan issued for your admission or student account. Check your name, program, fee amount and due date. Deposit the payment using the bank or payment method printed on the challan. Keep the paid receipt and upload or submit its proof wherever your admission or department instructions require. Do not use an old challan for a new semester without confirmation.

Under the refund schedule published in the UOS FAQ, semester or trimester students qualify for a 100% refund up to the 7th day after classes commence, 50% from day 8 through day 15, and no refund from day 16 onward. For annual-system students, the published schedule is 100% up to day 15, 50% from day 16 through day 30, and no refund from day 31 onward. The rules and the nature of the charges must be checked before claiming a refund.

keywords: can i transfer my admission fee
reply: According to the UOS admissions FAQ, admission fees may be transferred from one program to another within the time schedule of the first three merit lists of regular and self-support admissions. Students must comply with the applicable admission and fee-transfer procedure within that period.

UOS provides information and opportunities relating to scholarships and financial assistance for eligible students. The availability of individual scholarships depends on the sponsoring scheme, eligibility requirements, financial circumstances, academic record and application period. Students may be asked for academic records, identity information and financial documents. Scholarship approval is not automatic simply because a student has received admission.

To apply for a UOS hostel, complete the hostel admission application and obtain a recommendation from the chairperson of your department. Submit the recommended form to the relevant admission office. Hostel administration considers merit and eligibility before approving allotment. Under the published hostel rules, an approved applicant must deposit the prescribed hostel fee within seven days using the specified voucher at HBL's UOS branch. Failure to pay in time may result in cancellation.

UOS describes hostel facilities that include furnished rooms, dining and mess services, laundry, canteens, common or reading rooms, visitor areas, internet and computer facilities, generators, geysers, water coolers, sports facilities, medical support, ambulance services and security arrangements. The availability and operation of individual facilities may differ between hostels.

The UOS Hall Council describes hostel security arrangements including security guards, boundary walls and CCTV surveillance. Hostel residents must also follow attendance, visitor and accommodation rules to support campus safety.

keywords: what time should hostel students return
reply: The published UOS hostel rules specify daily boarder attendance between 9:30 PM and 10:30 PM, during which boarders are required to be present in their rooms. Residents must also follow any updated instructions issued by their hostel administration.

Hostel residents must pay the prescribed accommodation charges after allotment approval. The published hostel regulations require payment within seven days of approval. An exact current hostel fee cannot be stated reliably here because charges may change with the hostel and academic session. The allotment voucher is the authoritative statement of the amount owed by the resident.

The University of Sargodha's main library is Wazir Agha Library. UOS describes a collection of about 100,000 books, local and international journals, online full-text databases, around 25,000 digital resources, and a computer lab with 50 internet-connected computers. It also uses a library management system to organise its resources.

Library book borrowing is managed through library membership and circulation procedures. A student should register or verify their borrowing eligibility, select the required book, have it issued through the library circulation desk and return it by the assigned due date. Borrowing limits, renewal permissions and overdue charges depend on the library's current circulation rules and are not the same for every borrower category.

The university library's exact operating hours can change for academic sessions, examination periods, weekends and public holidays. A current daily opening and closing timetable is not included in the verified information available to this offline chatbot, so it cannot responsibly give an exact hour or confirm Sunday opening.

UOS does not use one universal timetable for every class and office. Lecture schedules vary by department, semester and program, while administrative offices may follow separate hours. Students receive class schedules from their department. This knowledge base does not contain a verified current university-wide opening and closing time.

The undergraduate dress code stated in the UOS FAQ is: male students wear grey trousers, a black belt, a white full-sleeved collared shirt and black shoes. Female students wear white shalwar kameez with a white dupatta featuring the appropriate faculty-coloured border, along with black shoes.

keywords: how to get student id card
reply: According to the UOS FAQ, students should contact the supporting office of their respective department to obtain their student ID card. The department can confirm the required information and procedure for new or replacement cards.

UOS allows a student to request a semester freeze before final-term examinations on medical grounds or circumstances beyond their control, subject to written permission from the concerned department chairperson, principal or director. The published FAQ states that the semester fee is not transferred or refunded because of the freeze, and student bonafide status is suspended during the freeze.

According to the UOS FAQ, students may be permitted to withdraw from a course during the specified 4–6-week period of the semester. An approved withdrawal is recorded with grade W and does not affect CGPA. The student must submit the relevant application through the department chairperson.

UOS's published FAQ states that an optional summer semester of approximately 8–9 weeks may be offered at the end of the academic year. It is intended for students who need to remove deficiencies, repeat failed courses, improve grades or address qualifying attendance-related examination restrictions, subject to eligibility and course availability.

UOS permits eligible students to improve grades by repeating courses offered during an appropriate regular or summer semester, within the allowed degree duration and after obtaining the relevant permission. The prescribed enrolment fee must be paid. The FAQ also states that students who improve through course repetition are not considered eligible for a position or scholarship in the relevant examination.

To request a UOS transcript, complete the required student biodata or transcript application formalities. Regular students must complete the relevant departmental clearance process. Applications may also be handled through the university Facilitation Centre with original documents. Requirements depend on whether the transcript is a first issue or a duplicate.

UOS has a degree and academic-record verification process managed through its Degree Cell. Applicants complete the prescribed application, provide their academic details, pay the required fee and submit the required hard-copy documents to the Assistant Controller, Degree Cell, Office of the Controller of Examinations, University of Sargodha. The published FAQ gives a processing period of 10 working days for verification.

According to the UOS FAQ, an English Proficiency Certificate can be requested from the University Facilitation Centre with original documents, or by submitting an application to the Registrar with an attested transcript copy, CNIC and paid processing-fee receipt. The FAQ lists a processing fee of Rs. 1,000 and indicates same-day issuance. Confirm the current charge when preparing the application.

Migration to UOS is considered under the university's migration policy. The applicant must come from an HEC-recognised university, meet UOS eligibility and merit requirements, and submit an application with identity documents, intermediate result, previous semester transcript, photographs, processing-fee receipt and course outlines where required. Migration is not granted during an incomplete first semester or year. An NOC from the previous university may be required during further processing.

UOS examination results are announced by the examination authorities for the relevant examination and session. To identify the correct result, students typically need their program or examination category, relevant session and roll number or registration details. Departmental semester results and centrally administered examinations may follow different publication procedures.

According to the UOS examination FAQ, a student may apply for paper rechecking within one month of the result declaration. The applicant must complete the prescribed rechecking form, pay the required challan and submit the documents to the Controller of Examinations or the Facilitation Centre. The published FAQ states that a final response is communicated in approximately 15 days.

UOS describes a Smart University wireless-network project providing Wi-Fi coverage across the main campus for eligible students and staff. Its campus information also mentions Eduroam, which supports access using institutional credentials at participating educational institutions. Access and sign-in instructions are managed by the university's IT services.

UOS provides sports and co-curricular opportunities for students. Campus activities include sporting events, seminars, conferences, workshops and student competitions. Participation arrangements and team selection depend on the relevant sports office, department and scheduled event.
